bŏiae , ārum, f. bos,
I.a collar for the neck, κλοιός (orig. of leather; hence the name; “but later of wood or iron),” Fest. p. 29 ; Isid. Orig. 5, 27, 12: boia κλοιός, Gloss. Vet.: “pedicae boiae,” Plaut. As. 3, 2, 5 : attrita boiis colla, Prud. Psych. praef. 34.—For boiam terere, v. Boii fin.
From A Latin Dictionary (Charlton T. Lewis, Charles Short, Oxford, Clarendon Press, 1879)
